call.transcript:
Agent: Thanks for calling Rivera and Associates. How can I help you today?
User: Hi, my name is Jordan Hale. I was rear-ended on I-10 last Tuesday and my neck still hurts.
Agent: I'm sorry to hear that. Were you taken to a hospital?
User: Yes, Memorial Hermann. They did X-rays. The other driver was a delivery van.
Agent: And the best number to reach you is the one you're calling from?
User: Yes, 555-123-0001.
Agent: We also sent a recap to your email after the call.
